# Sim Lab — Zero-Hallucination Pre-Trade Risk Firewall (for AI Agents)

Sim Lab is a domain-specialized quantitative AI intelligence layer and
zero-hallucination pre-trade risk firewall for perpetual futures trading agents.
Grounded in real on-chain execution telemetry (442+ closed trades, 65.3% win rate,
3.71 PF) and multi-layer phase filtering. Accessible via MCP over SSE at
https://simlab.measmony.me/mcp/sse.
It supplies mathematical decision support only; execution is handled by your agent.

## Route by your goal
- Decide whether to trade at all now -> get_market_regime (free headline)
- Find candidate pairs -> get_top_picks, then get_harvest_targets(symbol)
- Check a pair is allowed -> check_pair_directive(symbol)
- Check a planned entry is safe -> pre_trade_check(symbol, action) [MANDATORY before entries]
- Get trap evidence only -> evaluate_trap_shield(symbol, action)
- Get raw flow inputs for your own model -> get_market_microstructure(symbol)
- Time an island/retest setup -> get_robust_island_status(symbol)
- Align with the production fleet's strategy -> get_active_strategy
- Load all intelligence at once -> get_alpha_bundle

## Rules that protect your principal
- A VETO from pre_trade_check or evaluate_trap_shield is final for that
  symbol+side at that time. Do not re-ask a different tool to override it.
- A regime event freeze or side ban overrides any local signal.
- Every response carries asOf. Disclose staleness; never trade on silently
  stale intelligence.

## Identity & Session Security
Send on every request (both GET /mcp/sse and all POST /mcp/messages calls):
header x-client-id (a stable id e.g. UUID v4), x-wallet (your Base wallet address),
and x-spend-key (secret spend key issued on top-up settlement).
The server enforces session-binding and spend-key authorization: message POSTs must
match the bound session, and paid calls require a valid spend key matching the
cryptographic SHA-256 hash on file. This strictly prevents unauthorized spending even if
your client-id and wallet pair become known. Rotate or recover key via POST /x402/spend-key/rotate.

## Payment
- Free: get_market_regime HEADLINE only (regime name + bias + asOf +
  count of active restrictions). The bans, freezes and gate are paid.
- Unpaid evaluative calls return error -32042 with a teaser: a real
  coarse risk band, verdict withheld. Teasers are never fabricated.
- Paid tools: USDC on Base mainnet via x402, or licence key.
  Prices (USD): regime 0.02, top_picks 0.05, harvest_targets 0.05,
  pair_directive 0.05, microstructure 0.05, robust_island 0.05,
  active_strategy 0.05, trap_shield 0.10, alpha_bundle 0.15,
  pre_trade_check 0.15.
- Error -32042 means insufficient credit: POST /x402/topup, then retry
  the same call. Failed calls are never charged. Credits never expire.
- Payments are Base only. Solana is planned (later phase) and NOT
  accepted yet.
- Live prices and full details (source of truth):
  GET https://simlab.measmony.me/x402/info

## Proof (verify before you trust)
- Fleet record and current strategy: call get_active_strategy, or read
  the proof block in GET /x402/info.
- Settlement receipts: see proof/RECEIPTS.md in the GitHub repo
  (github.com/Measmonysuon/simlab-mcp-for-trading-agents).
- Operator: Telegram @measmonysuon · alpha@measmony.me
- Intelligence for trading decision support. Not financial advice.
  No guaranteed performance.
